task.topic: Among patients undergoing pars plana vitrectomy, does conventional 20-gauge surgery versus microincision vitrectomy surgery change the risks of intraoperative iatrogenic retinal breaks or postoperative retinal detachment?

outcomes: Intraoperative iatrogenic retinal break or tear detected during vitrectomy

outcome.description: Intraoperative iatrogenic retinal break or tear detected during vitrectomy

targets.effect_selection_rule: Retain one arm-level result per independent report for the intraoperative target. Prefer all eligible surgical indications combined when the source reports that aggregate. Do not select a postoperative retinal-detachment result.

field_definitions.20g_events: Eyes with an intraoperative target break in the conventional 20-gauge arm.
field_definitions.mivs_events: Eyes with an intraoperative target break in the MIVS arm.
field_definitions.mivs_total: Eyes analyzed in the MIVS arm.

derivation_preconditions: The 23-gauge and 25-gauge arms are disjoint arms in the same report and use the same intraoperative outcome definition.
derivation_instructions: When a study presents both eligible 23G and 25G arms, sum events and totals to form one MIVS comparator before the study-level comparison.
source_aggregation_rules: Do not merge participants across different reports.
Do not merge postoperative outcomes with intraoperative outcomes.

extraction_notes: The unit is an eye/procedure as reported by the source; preserve the reported denominator.
An included report lacking the intraoperative target remains visible as source-only evidence, not a zero-event study.

extraction.model_selection_policy: Retain one arm-level result per independent report for the intraoperative target. Prefer all eligible surgical indications combined when the source reports that aggregate. Do not select a postoperative retinal-detachment result.
extraction.exclusion_concepts: The unit is an eye/procedure as reported by the source; preserve the reported denominator. An included report lacking the intraoperative target remains visible as source-only evidence, not a zero-event study.
extraction.evidence_requirements: Every extracted record must retain exact source evidence, page, source-defined effect scale, exposure unit, adjustment set, and missingness.
